response.rationale: A and B are the same concept: the ice-rink Session entity. In A, ReportService constructor-injects SessionRepository and calls SessionRepository.list. Its `for (const s of this.sessions.list())` loop goes through the sessions that SessionRepository stores in `new Map<string, Session>()`, which is B. The graph also shows ReportService.weekly calling SessionRepository. "Ice Session" is just a more specific label for the same Session class, which RinkService and IceMonitorService also manage. The two names refer to one real-world thing.
